tolerances.name: seeded_reproduction
tolerances.units: percentage points between retained draws of two runs at the same seed
tolerances.rationale: A rerun on one implementation and architecture must return every retained draw unchanged. The recorded amd64 and arm64 runs compare the same values; their maximum floating-point difference sets the cross-architecture bound.

tolerances.name: interval_endpoint_precision
tolerances.units: percentage points between the extreme interval endpoints of runs differing only in seed
tolerances.rationale: The Monte Carlo error of a published interval endpoint at 10000 draws per day. It bounds how much of a reported interval is sampling noise rather than estimated uncertainty, and it is measured, never enlarged afterwards.

tolerances.name: coverage_boundary_stability
tolerances.units: percentage points over retained days after moving both support boundaries
tolerances.rationale: The registered 7, 14 and 30 day boundary shifts remain below the frozen support bound for every modeled component.

tolerances.name: snapshot_drift
tolerances.units: percentage points after an addition/deletion or fixed correction of one source row
tolerances.rationale: The largest corrected-history revision after removing each institute's last eligible development poll, which also measures adding it back, or moving 0.1 points from OTHER to M in that poll.
